cases.sentence: Обращаю взгляд свой к ___, откуда придет мне помощь.
cases.translation: I lift my eyes to the hills, where does my help come from?
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) governs the dative case.

cases.translation: My help comes from the Lord.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) governs the genitive case.
The transitive verb сотворивший (created) governs the accusative case.

cases.translation: He will not allow your foot to be moved.
cases.explain: The transitive verb позволит (allow) governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Истинно хранящий ___ не задремлет и не уснет.
cases.translation: The keeper of Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
cases.explain: The transitive verb хранящий (keeping) governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Господь — ___ твой по правую руку твою.
cases.translation: The Lord is your shade on your right hand.
cases.explain: Тень is a predicate nominative after the copula.

reading.ru: Обращаю взгляд свой к горам, откуда придет мне помощь.
reading.question: Where does the psalmist look for help?
reading.explain: The verse clearly states: Обращаю взгляд свой к горам — I lift my eyes to the hills.

reading.ru: Помощь мне придет от Господа, сотворившего небо и землю.
reading.question: Who is the source of help according to this verse?
options: The Lord who made heaven and earth
reading.correct: The Lord who made heaven and earth
reading.explain: The verse answers its own question: Помощь мне придет от Господа, сотворившего небо и землю — My help comes from the Lord, who made heaven and earth.

reading.ru: Он не позволит ноге твоей пошатнуться, хранящий тебя не задремлет.
reading.question: What two things does God do for those He keeps?
options: He will not allow your foot to slip, and He will not slumber
He gives you strength and wisdom
He grants you riches and fame
reading.correct: He will not allow your foot to slip, and He will not slumber
reading.explain: The verse gives two assurances: Он не позволит ноге твоей пошатнуться (He won't allow your foot to slip) and хранящий тебя не задремлет (He who keeps you won't slumber).

reading.ru: Истинно хранящий Израиль не задремлет и не уснет.
reading.question: What is emphasized about God's vigilance for Israel?
reading.explain: The verse emphasizes that the keeper of Israel (God) не задремлет и не уснет — neither slumbers nor sleeps.

reading.ru: Солнце не поразит тебя днем, ни луна ночью.
reading.question: What protection does God provide from celestial bodies?
options: The sun won't strike you by day, nor the moon by night
The sun gives light and the moon gives rest
reading.correct: The sun won't strike you by day, nor the moon by night
reading.explain: The verse promises comprehensive protection: Солнце не поразит тебя днем, ни луна ночью — The sun won't harm you by day, nor the moon by night.

reading.ru: Господь будет хранить тебя, когда ты будешь уходить и когда будешь приходить отныне и вовеки.
reading.question: During what times will God keep the psalmist?
options: When he goes out and when he comes in, now and forevermore
reading.correct: When he goes out and when he comes in, now and forevermore
reading.explain: The verse provides comprehensive assurance: Господь будет хранить тебя, когда ты будешь уходить и когда будешь приходить отныне и вовеки — The Lord will keep you when you go out and when you come in, from now on and forever.
